name: gross_to_net_ratio
used_in: salary multiple when basis = gross and gross income is not given
rationale: Typical take-home after PF and tax for a mid-income salaried employee
evidence_or_source: modelling assumption (flagged in output whenever used)

name: gst_on_fees
rationale: GST on financial service charges in India
evidence_or_source: Stated on lender pages (e.g. Indian Bank 'GST 18% as on date'); applied unless the lender says its fee already includes GST

name: credit_card_obligation_share
rationale: Bureaus show revolving balances, not EMIs; lenders commonly treat ~5% of card outstanding as the monthly obligation
evidence_or_source: industry convention; not published by any lender in the set

name: rate_band_template
unit: position between lender's published min and max rate
used_in: expected rate for lenders without a published CIBIL table
rationale: Shape of Union Bank's published CIBIL table (sec 7.1, w.e.f. 08.10.2026), normalised; no-history applicants priced in the 750-799 band as Union and PNB both do
evidence_or_source: retail_roi.pdf; cross-checked against HDFC's published Q1 FY27 average rate (see README)

name: borderline_cibil_margin
rationale: A score within 20 points of a cut-off can fall below it after one late payment or new enquiry

name: borderline_foir_margin
unit: share of income below the FOIR cap
rationale: Less than 5% of income left under the cap means a small rise in obligations or rate breaks it

name: borderline_income_margin
rationale: Income within 10% of the floor is sensitive to how the lender computes net income

name: borderline_tenure_margin
rationale: Lenders verify service dates from documents; a few months of slack avoids rounding rejections

name: estimate_ranking_penalty
unit: percentage points of APR per estimated deciding field
rationale: Prefer a lender whose deciding rules are verified when costs are close

name: simulation_population
rationale: Synthetic salaried population for rule-level insights; not real applicants. Income log-normal (median Rs 35k); 10% no credit history, others CIBIL ~ normal(730, 55). All distributions are assumptions, no public lender-level data exists

name: calculator_reference_tenure
rationale: The Axis calculator returns an amount, not a tenure; a 15x multiple implies an EMI at a standard tenure. When age forces a shorter tenure the multiple is scaled by the annuity factor so the EMI is unchanged
